resources.fit: gen_corpus lacks: uppercase letters in the text pool (folding barely exercised), '\n' in random text ('$'-before-newline and '.'/[^x] vs newline untested), semantics tags for Perl-vs-JS-divergent cases, kept 'must reject' cases (random errors are discarded), limit/boundary cases (pattern/text/group/nesting at limit-1/limit/limit+1), invalid UTF-8 and NUL (argv cannot carry NUL: needs a hex/stdin mode), anchored/match-at-pos and find-all iteration (empty-match advance over a multibyte char), a shrinker, and Python-only-syntax cases ({,n}, lone '{' ']' '}'). difftest lacks: batch/in-process mode (needed for 1e5+ cases), crash/signal detection (a segfault shows as 'got <empty>'), strict group checking (an engine printing no group lines passes; unset '-1 -1' not enforced), a policy for 'error' expectations (any output passes), per-feature-tag failure classification, resource checks (stack/step budget) beyond the 2 s wall clock, and JSON output with case ids for CI.

local_oracles:
pcre2test 10.47 (2025-10-21, /opt/homebrew/bin; 8/16/32-bit, UTF+UCP Unicode 16.0, JIT; libpcre2-8 via pkg-config). Input '/pat/mods' + indented subjects; modifiers utf, ucp, caseless(i), caseless_restrict(r), dollar_endonly, dfa, jit, ovector; subject modifier '\=match_limit=N'. Verified semantics = Perl: (|a)+ on aaa -> 0:'' 1:''; (a*)* on b -> 1:''; abc$ matches 'abc
' unless dollar_endonly; utf mode: '.' = one code point, offsets are bytes, \w\d\s ASCII unless ucp, but caseless folds non-ASCII (é/É match even with caseless_restrict; k/U+212A blocked only by restrict); accepts a{,2} as {0,2} (Perl 5.34 too; JS-u: SyntaxError); rejects a**, a{2,1}, [z-a] (errors 109/104/108); ^(a+)+$ hits 'match limit exceeded' (-47). $S/survey_testing/pcre2_oracle.c wraps it in the engine-CLI contract (PCRE2_UTF|PCRE2_DOLLAR_ENDONLY, match_limit 200000): 2079/2081 agreement with the Python corpus. Python 3.11.14 re (/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.11; also 3.13 present): the corpus oracle; re.ASCII makes \d\w\s AND case folding ASCII-only (é/i vs É -> None, k/i vs U+212A -> None: exact fit for the spec); matches code points; byte offsets via len(text[:i].encode()). Caveats: Perl-style empty-iteration captures ((a*)* on b -> g1 (0,0); JS: unset), (|a)+ on aaa -> (0,0) (JS: (0,3)); '$' matches before a trailing 
 (JS: no); accepts a{,2}, 'a{', lone ']' '}' as literals; no match limit (^(a+)+$ on 22 a's+b takes 0.19 s; corpus relies on difftest's 2 s timeout). Node v26.5.0 (JS oracle, $S/survey_testing/js_oracle.mjs with flags 'u'+'d' and UTF-16->UTF-8 offset conversion): 26/2081 disagreements with the corpus, all explained by empty-iteration capture reset, the (|a)+ exit rule and Unicode folding under 'iu' (é/É, [a-z] vs U+017F, \w vs U+212A all match). Without 'u': '.' is a UTF-16 unit (^.$ fails on emoji) and 'a{' / 'a{,2}' are literals. Perl 5.34.1 (/usr/bin/perl -Mutf8 -CS; @-/@+ are character offsets): agrees with PCRE2 on every probe (é/É fold, (|a)+ -> (0,0), abc$ matches before trailing 
). macOS libc regcomp/regexec (regex(3), TRE-derived): POSIX leftmost-longest with POSIX subexpression rules — (a|ab)(c|bcd)(d*) on abcd gives g1=(0,2) g2=(2,3) g3=(3,4) where Perl/JS/Python give (0,1)(1,4)(4,4) -> NOT usable as a submatch oracle. REG_EXTENDED|REG_ENHANCED adds \d \w \s, (?:...), lazy *? +? {n,m}? (verified); plain ERE rejects a*? ('repetition-operator operand invalid') and x(a|)y ('empty (sub)expression') and treats \d as no-match. With setlocale(LC_ALL,'en_US.UTF-8') '.' consumes a whole code point and rm_so/rm_eo are BYTE offsets (^..$ on 日本 -> 0..6, (.)(.) on éő -> g1=0,2 g2=2,4); in the C locale '.' is one byte. Usable only for match-existence / overall-span cross-checks on group-free patterns and as a crash/hang sanity oracle. Also present: libonig 6.9.10 (libonig.a, onig-config; ONIG_SYNTAX_PERL_NT selectable; not probed), Go 1.26.5 (RE2 semantics; not probed), arm-none-eabi-gcc 10.3.1 + arm-none-eabi-size, Apple clang 21 with ASan/UBSan but NO libFuzzer runtime. Absent: bloaty (brew has 1.1), puncover, afl-fuzz (no brew formula), klee, hypothesis, exrex, re2, tre.
recommended_strategy:
Decide semantics first: SEMANTICS.md fixes the divergences measured on the corpus (26/2081 Node vs Python): empty-iteration captures ((a*)* on b: Perl g1=(0,0), JS unset), the (|a)+ exit rule, '$' before a trailing newline (Perl yes, JS no), Python-only syntax ({,n}, lone '{'), and ASCII-only folding (Python re.ASCII is the exact oracle). Tag each divergent corpus case.
1. Unit tests (host): one table file in the rust regex-test schema (byte spans, [] = unset; JSONL or TOML) run by a 20-line jera-MinUnit-style harness or greatest.h (ISC, 5.4 KB); build with -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined. Seeds, all re-oracled through Python re.ASCII: gen_corpus HAND list; Go's leftmost-first Fowler .dat (~350 ERE rows, 40-line loader ported from parseFowlerResult); re_tests.py (177 in-subset); test262 exec cases (112 in-subset); PCRE2 testinput1 (499 in-subset patterns). Add limit cases (pattern/text/group count/nesting at limit-1/limit/limit+1), malformed patterns (must return error, never crash), invalid UTF-8 and NUL via a hex-input CLI mode, anchored and match-at-pos.
2. Conformance corpus: commit corpus_seed1/seed7 with expectations cross-checked by pcre2_oracle (2079/2081) and js_oracle (2055/2081); divergent cases carry the semantics tag. Zero failures required; difftest gains stdin-batch mode, crash/signal accounting, strict group lines, per-tag failure table, JSON output.
3.
